author: @jeremyfowers

evidence.api_compatibility: No breaking API changes. The fix corrects a bug where the bare form and extra. form of one name resolved to different publishers. The change aligns runtime behavior with the documented spec in docs/guide/configuration/custom-models.md. Users who depended on the buggy last-wins behavior for the extra. form will see a different model, but this is a bug fix to documented behavior, not an undocumented API change.
evidence.documentation: Updated docs/guide/configuration/custom-models.md to add an example showing how shared folder names are handled (alpha/Shared + beta/Shared example). The collision row in the naming table was amended to mention earlier-folder ownership alongside the existing collision-with-another-model rule.
evidence.manual_release_testing: The behavior change is covered by CI-executed tests that exercise the model-resolution path through the server endpoint and C++ unit tests. No user-visible surface requires manual exercise beyond what CI already validates.
evidence.post_approval_commits: None. @fl0rianr's final approval (2026-10-02T14:16:36Z) came after the last commit (6874706). The iterative fix cycle — review, fix, re-review, approve — follows the project's guideline that PRs should be thoroughly reviewed before merge.
evidence.review: PR #3657 received two rounds of substantive review from @fl0rianr. First review identified a mixed layout bug (later single-model folder registering extra.Shared as canonical ID, shadowing the earlier variant folder). @jeremyfowers responded with a follow-up commit (c5c71fd). Second review caught a second edge case: the qualified fallback only checked canonical IDs, not kept folder-name aliases, so beta/Shared could become extra.beta-Shared and shadow an earlier alias. @jeremyfowers addressed this in the third commit (6874706) making ids and kept folder names share one claimed_names set, and @fl0rianr gave final approval. All three commits were reviewed; no unapproved changes.
evidence.security: Low risk. The change only affects model name resolution for files in a user-configured extra_models_dir — a local filesystem scope. No new network calls, credential handling, or permission changes. CodeQL and security checks all passed.
evidence.tests: Two new C++ unit tests in test/cpp/test_extra_model_discovery.cpp and two new Python server-endpoint tests in test/server_endpoints.py (test_021yg_extra_shared_folder_name_has_one_owner, test_021ygb_extra_shared_folder_name_qualifies_a_later_single_model). The author confirmed each new test fails before the fix and passes after. All 15 existing extra_models_dir tests and the full C++ test_extra_model_discovery suite pass. No existing tests weakened or deleted.

shout_outs.reason: Caught two distinct edge cases in review (mixed single-model/variant folder layouts, qualified ID shadowing kept folder names) and materially drove their fixes through iterative follow-up commits.

subject: fix(models): give a shared folder name to one model in both forms (#3657)
summary: Fixes model name resolution so that when multiple folders share the same name (e.g., bartowski/Qwen3-8B-GGUF and lmstudio-community/Qwen3-8B-GGUF), the bare model name and the extra. prefix form resolve to the same publisher's model — the first folder found owns the name in both forms, and later folders with the same name are qualified with their containing folder.
verdict_reason: The fix is narrowly scoped, substantively reviewed with two rounds of follow-up, and covered by new C++ and Python server-endpoint tests plus documentation updates.
